{{Lang|Yirou|zh=意柔|zh_rm=Yìróu}} is an NPC in {{Location|Memento Square}}.

==Location==
Yirou can be found in Memento Square after completing the quest [[Utterance of Marvels: II]].

<gallery>
Work Report on Exploration Site Selection-Part One Location.png|Yirou's location
NPC Location Yirou Context.png|Additional context
</gallery>

==Profile==
Yirou is one of the leaders of the restoration of [[Memento Square]]. She holds the Sentinel [[Jué]] in high regard, which is why she puts such a high value on repairing and restoring the statue. In her opinion, this project will help inspire and console the people of [[Jinzhou]] in the face of the attacks and disasters of the [[Tacet Discord]]s. This idealistic perspective is at odds with [[Hao'bai]], who believes that the main priority of the project should be repairing and defending the area. 

Yirou seems oblivious to Hao'bai's feelings for her,<ref>Dialogue with [[Hao'bai]]</ref> but others in the camp have commented on their conflicting opinions.<ref>Dialogue with [[Xianfeng]]</ref>

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Yirou:''' Just curious why they haven't started repairing the Sentinel statue yet...
:'''Yirou:''' All the issues mentioned in the report can be solved!
:{{DIcon}} What's wrong with it all?
:'''Yirou:''' The mountains and rocks are unstable... Frequent [[Tacet Discord]] Outbreaks...
:{{DIcon}} I'm afrain it won't be resolved for a while.
:{{DIcon}} Not a small problem indeed.
:'''Yirou:''' People are living in fear, afraid that these disasters will happen again...
:'''Yirou:''' A restoration of the Sentinel sculpture would surely inspire everyone.
:'''Yirou:''' After all, we all grew up listening to Sentinel's stories!
{{Dialogue End}}
